description:
PROBLEM TYPE: LP

PROBLEM INFO:

- A division of an auto parts manufacturer produces \var{P} different parts using \var{M} different machines.
- Batch of 100 part \var{p} requires \var{time_{m,p}} hours on machine \var{m}.
- The division incurs a charge of \var{cost_{m}} per hour for using machine \var{m}.
- Machine \var{m} has an availability of up to \var{available_{m}} hours per month.
- The division sells part \var{p} in batches of 100 at price of \var{price_{p}} per batch.
- The division must produce at least \var{min_batches_{p}} batches of part \var{p} each month to fulfill a contract.
- Machine \var{1} is being outsourced so that the manufacturer must pay for the labor.
- The labor costs $\var{standard_cost}/h up to \var{overtime_hour} hours, after which it costs $\var{overtime_cost}/h due to overtime.
- Individual availability conditions for Machine \var{1} can be disregarded.

INPUT FORMAT: 

{
    "time_required": [[time_{m,p} for p in 1, ..., P] for m in 1, ..., M],
    "machine_costs": [cost_{m} for m in 1, ..., M],
    "availability": [available_{m} for m in 1, ..., M],
    "prices": [price_{p} for p in 1, ..., P],
    "min_batches": [min_batches_{p} for p in 1, ..., P],
    "standard_cost": standard_cost,
    "overtime_cost": overtime_cost,
    "overtime_hour": overtime_hour
}

OBJECTIVE: How many batches of each part should the manufacturer produce each month to maximize profit?

OUTPUT INFO:

- the number of batches of each part produced \var{batches_{p}}.
- \var{total_profit} represents the total profit obtained for the month.

OUTPUT FORMAT:

{
    "batches": [batches_{p} for p in 1, ..., P],
    "total_profit": total_profit
}

TimeRequired.definition: Time required to produce one batch of part p on machine m

MachineCosts.definition: Cost of operating machine m for one month

Availability.definition: Number of hours machine m is available each month without overtime

Prices.definition: Price received for selling one batch of part p

MinBatches.definition: Minimum number of batches of part p to be produced

StandardCost.definition: Standard cost for operating all machines during normal operating hours

OvertimeCost.definition: Extra cost for operating a machine in overtime per hour

OvertimeHour.definition: Number of overtime hours available for machine m

objective.description: "Maximize the total monthly profit, defined as total revenue from selling all produced batches minus the operating and labor costs of the machines (including standard and overtime costs)."

constraints.description: For each machine m ≠ 1: sum over all parts p of (TimeRequired[m,p] * batches_p) must be less than or equal to Availability[m]
For machine 1: regular_hours + overtime_hours = sum over all parts p of (TimeRequired[1,p] * batches_p)
constraints.code:
model.addConstr(
    regularHours1 + overtimeHours1 ==
    sum(TimeRequired[0][p] * batches[p] for p in range(NumParts))
)

constraints.description: For machine 1: regular_hours must be less than or equal to OvertimeHour[1]
For each part p: batches_p must be greater than or equal to MinBatches[p]
constraints.code:
for p in range(NumParts):
    model.addConstr(batches[p] >= MinBatches[p])

constraints.description: regular_hours must be greater than or equal to 0
overtime_hours must be greater than or equal to 0

batches.definition: Number of batches of part p produced per month

regularHours1.definition: Number of regular operating hours used on machine 1

overtimeHours1.definition: Number of overtime operating hours used on machine 1
